description.zh: 按关键词采集抖音搜索结果的分享链接与点赞/评论/收藏计数，落盘到 records.jsonl 后批量上报到服务端。再次采到同一个视频时会就地更新那一行的三个计数。支持分片与断点续跑，附带一个连续采集与上报的工作流模板。
description.en: Collect Douyin share links plus like/comment/collect counts for a keyword, append them to records.jsonl and upload them to your server. Re-collecting a video updates that video's three counts in place. Supports chunked resumable runs and ships a continuous collect-and-upload workflow template.

description.zh: 一轮采一片搜索结果的分享链接并上报，整轮结束后随机等 30–120 秒接着跑下一轮。导入后可以改关键词、条数与间隔。
description.en: Each round collects one chunk of share links and uploads it, then waits a random 30–120 seconds before the next round. Edit the keyword, item count and gap after importing.
